name: analyst_email_address
description: Electronic mail address of the learning support analyst. Compared against the session user function inside the row access policy.

name: local_authority_name
description: Name of a local authority that this analyst is contracted to support.

name: entitlement_is_active
description: True while the entitlement is in force. Setting this column to false removes access at the next query without any change to identity and access management.

name: entitlement_reviewed_date
description: Date on which this entitlement was last reviewed by the data platform engineering group.

name: entitlement_review_reference
description: Reference of the access review record that authorised this entitlement.
